notes: Seeded engine definitions for Add engine. Data only: titles may name common servers, detection rules name API shapes. The metadata rows and the 5a rules come from ~/Documents/azizam/ux-findings/add-engine-probe-table.md (measured 2026-10-14).

evidence_text.likely_model_field: Its model list marks “{model}” as a {noun} model.
evidence_text.likely_model_field_many: Its model list marks “{model}” and {others} other models as {noun} models.
evidence_text.likely_metadata: Its {document} lists {path}, and the route answered.
evidence_text.likely_test: A real test passed at {time}. That shows the server can do this.
evidence_text.possible: The {noun} route answered an empty request with “{status_text}”. That shows the route exists.
evidence_text.possible_why: A “{status_short}” answer shows the route exists, not that a model can do this. Run a real test to find out.
evidence_text.none: The route answered “{status_text}”, the same as a path that does not exist.
evidence_text.none_server_error: The route answered with a server error, “{status_text}”. That proves nothing.
evidence_text.none_nothing_recognised: The server answered every standard request with “not supported” or “not found”.
evidence_text.needs_key: The route exists, but it is locked: it answered “{status_text}”.
evidence_text.needs_key_why: Add the key, then check again.
evidence_text.declared: You chose this kind and gave the path {path}. An empty request to that path answered “{status_text}”, so the path exists.
evidence_text.declared_unchecked: You chose this kind and gave the path {path}.
evidence_text.workflow: The workflow ends in a node that saves {makes}.
evidence_text.none_unlisted: Nothing the server publishes mentions it.

model_rules_note: A capabilities array that holds only "completion" is not chat evidence (5a): an embedding-only server reports it too. No rule maps it.

chat.sent: One chat message, “Say OK”, with a limit of 1 token

images.sent: One request for a 64-pixel image of “a red dot”

rerank.sent: One question and two short texts

stt.sent: One second of silence, as a WAV file of 32 KB

graph.sent: Your workflow, with the seed set to −1, a value the server must refuse
graph.cost: None. Nothing was queued or generated.

advice.title: Azizam will not call this address
advice.what: Azizam did not send anything to {host}.
advice.why: {reason}
advice.fix: Use the address of the engine itself, not of the gateway or of the computer’s cloud settings service.

advice.title: Address not found
advice.what: Azizam could not find the computer called {host}.
advice.why: The name does not resolve to an address on this network.
advice.fix: Check the spelling of the address, or use the computer’s IP address instead.

advice.title: Server not reachable
advice.what: Azizam could not reach the server.
advice.why: Nothing answered at {host} within {timeout_words}. The server may be off, or the address or port may be wrong.
advice.fix: Check that the server is running and that the address and port are right. If Azizam runs in a container, “localhost” means the container, not your computer. If Azizam should start this server itself, add it kept off, then set its start command on the engine page.
advice.fix_admin: Check that the server is running and that the address and port are right. If Azizam runs in a container, “localhost” means the container, not your computer. If the server starts only when needed, add it kept off and ask the owner to set its start command.

advice.title: Secure connection failed
advice.what: Azizam reached {host}, but the secure connection failed.
advice.why: The server’s certificate is not trusted, or the server does not speak https on this port.
advice.fix: If the server has no certificate, use http:// instead of https://. Otherwise install a certificate this computer trusts.

advice.title: The server sent Azizam somewhere else
advice.what: The server answered with a redirect to {location}.
advice.why: Azizam does not follow redirects when it checks a server, so a key is never sent to a place you did not type.
advice.fix: Type the address the redirect points to, if you trust it, then check again.

advice.title: The answer was too large
advice.what: The server sent more than Azizam reads during a check.
advice.why: A model list or a status page is small. A large answer usually means the address points at something else.
advice.fix: Check the address and the port.

advice.title: Key refused
advice.what: The server refused the key.
advice.why: It answered “{status_text}”. The key may be mistyped, out of date, or made for another server.
advice.fix: Paste the key again. If the server lists its keys in its own settings, make a new one and paste that.

advice.title: This server needs a key
advice.what: This server needs a key.
advice.why: Every real route answered “{status_text}”, but a made-up path answered “{baseline_text}”. So the routes exist and are locked.
advice.why_everywhere: Every path answered “{status_text}”, even a made-up one. The server wants a key before it says anything.
advice.fix: Paste the key the server expects, then continue. Azizam stores it and never shows it again.
advice.fix_admin: This server needs a key, and only the owner can add one. Save it without a key and ask the owner, or ask the owner to add it.
advice.summary_admin: This server needs a key. Only the owner can add one.

advice.title: The server asked Azizam to slow down
advice.what: The server answered “429 Too Many Requests”.
advice.why: It limits how often it answers, and the limit is used up.
advice.fix: Wait a minute, then check again.

advice.title: No model list at this address
advice.what: The address answered, but it has no list of models.
advice.why: The server returned “404 Not Found” for {route}, the same as for a made-up path. The API probably starts one level deeper.
advice.fix: Add /v1 to the end of the address, then check again.

advice.title: No model list at this address
advice.what: The address answered, but it has no list of models.
advice.why: The server returned “404 Not Found” for {route}.
advice.fix: Check the address and the port with whoever set up the server.

advice.title: The server had an error
advice.what: The server answered “{status_text}”.
advice.why: Something is wrong on the server itself. Its own text is under Details.
advice.fix: Look at the server’s own log, fix the problem there, then check again.

advice.title: The path answered with a server error
advice.what: The server answered “{status_text}” at POST {url}.
advice.why: An empty request can make a server fail even when the path is right. A server error proves nothing either way.
advice.fix: Run a real test on the next screen. If it fails too, check the path and the server’s own log.

advice.title: The server has no model list
advice.what: The server answers, but it does not list its models at {route}.
advice.why: Some servers serve one model and never list it.
advice.fix: Add the model by name on the next screens.

advice.title: The server answers, but not in the expected shape
advice.what: The address answered {route}, but not with a list of models.
advice.why: The answer is not the shape this kind of server sends. The address may point at a different kind of server.
advice.fix: Check that you picked the right kind. Or add the server anyway and say yourself what it can do.

advice.title: Nothing recognised
advice.what: Azizam could not tell what this server can do.
advice.why: The server is reachable and did not refuse the key. But it listed no models, and it answered every standard request with “not supported” or “not found”.
advice.fix: Check that the address ends where the API starts, often /v1. Or add the server anyway and say yourself what it can do.

advice.title: The server lists no models
advice.what: The server answered, but its model list is empty.
advice.why: Nothing is loaded yet, or the server loads models only when asked.
advice.fix: Load a model on the server and check again, or add a model by name on the next screens.

advice.title: Already added
advice.what: An engine already uses this address.
advice.why: “{existing_name}” points to {address}. Adding it twice would split its load and its history.
advice.fix: Open the engine that exists, or change the address.

definitions.title: Any OpenAI-compatible server
definitions.example: For example, vLLM, llama.cpp or LM Studio
definitions.summary: Chat, embeddings, reranking, speech, transcription and images. Azizam finds out which of these the server offers.

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Where the server listens, with its port. Usually ends in /v1.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Leave empty if the server has no key.

fields.label: Environment variable name
fields.help: Azizam reads the key from this variable on the gateway’s computer. Only the name is saved. The value is never shown.

fields.label: Request headers
fields.help: Extra headers Azizam sends with every request to this server, for example X-Client: azizam-home.

fields.label: Time to wait for a reply
fields.help: Raise this for slow models.

fields.label: Extra path before every request
fields.help: Leave empty unless the server needs one, for example /openai. Azizam puts it between the address and each route.

fields.label: Key header name
fields.help: The header that carries the key. Most servers use Authorization. Some use X-API-Key.

fields.label: Request adjustments
fields.help: Fix a mismatch between what apps send and what this server accepts, for example leave out a field the server refuses. Each one says in plain words what it does.

fields.label: Who starts and stops this server
Start command
fields.help: Run on the gateway’s computer when a request needs this server.

fields.label: Wait for it to be ready
Stop when idle for
fields.help: 0 means never.

fields.label: Address

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Leave empty if the server has no key.

fields.label: Environment variable name
fields.help: Azizam reads the key from this variable on the gateway’s computer. Only the name is saved. The value is never shown.

fields.label: Time to wait for a reply
fields.help: Raise this for slow models.

fields.label: Who starts and stops this server
Wait for it to be ready

check_rows: Reading what each model can do
definitions.models_note: This server loads a model the first time something asks for it. That first request can take a while.

advice.title: No model list at this address
advice.what: The address answered, but it has no model list of its own.
advice.why: The server returned “404 Not Found” for /api/tags. An address that ends in /v1 points at the OpenAI-style part of a server, which has no such list.
advice.fix: Take /v1 off the end of the address, then check again.

advice.title: No model list at this address
advice.what: The address answered, but it has no model list of its own.
advice.why: The server returned “404 Not Found” for /api/tags.
advice.fix: Check the port. The usual port for this kind of server is 11434.

advice.title: Nothing recognised
advice.what: Azizam could not tell what this server can do.
advice.why: The server is reachable and did not refuse the key. But its model list is empty, so it has nothing to offer yet.
advice.fix: Pull a model on the server, then check again. Or add the server anyway and say yourself what it can do.

definitions.title: Node-graph image and video server
definitions.summary: Runs a workflow file. You pick the file and say which inputs it takes.

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Where the server listens, with its port. Usually port 8188. Do not add /v1.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Leave empty if the server has no key.

fields.label: Environment variable name
fields.help: Azizam reads the key from this variable on the gateway’s computer. Only the name is saved. The value is never shown.

fields.label: Workflow file
fields.help: A .json file in API format, up to 20 MB.

fields.label: Name apps use
fields.help: Apps ask for this workflow by this name, for example “sdxl-text-to-image”.

fields.label: Time to wait for a reply
fields.help: Pictures and video take longer than text.

fields.label: Who starts and stops this server
Wait for it to be ready

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.help: The words an app sends, for example “a red bicycle”.
inputs.matched_note: Matched on its own: node {node}, “{title}”, feeds the sampler’s positive input.

inputs.label: Image in
inputs.help: A picture an app sends to edit or to start from.
inputs.missing_note: This file has no node that loads an image, so image-in stays off.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: Azizam sends a new random number each time, unless an app sets one.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: How long the server refines the picture. Left unused, the file’s own value stays.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.help: Which model file the server loads, for example “sd_xl_base_1.0”.

advice.title: This does not look like a node-graph server
advice.what: The address answered, but it has no node catalog.
advice.why: The server returned “404 Not Found” for /system_stats, the same as for a made-up path.
advice.fix: Check the address and the port. The usual port for this kind of server is 8188.

advice.title: This file is not in API format
advice.what: Azizam read “{file}”, but it only holds the picture of the graph: where the boxes sit and what colour they are.
advice.why: The editor saves two kinds of file. The server runs only the API kind, which lists each step and its settings.
advice.fix: In the editor, choose “Export (API)”, then pick that new file here.
advice.raw_label: What Azizam found in the file

definitions.title: Speech-to-text server with a custom path

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Where the server listens, with its port. Leave the path out. It goes in the next field.

fields.label: Path on the server
fields.help: The part after the address that accepts audio, starting with /. For example /inference. Ask whoever set up the server if you are not sure.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Leave empty if the server has no key.

fields.label: Environment variable name
fields.help: Azizam reads the key from this variable on the gateway’s computer. Only the name is saved. The value is never shown.

fields.label: Public name
fields.help: The name apps use to pick this model, for example “whisper”.

fields.label: Name the server uses (optional)
fields.help: Sent as the model name with every request. Leave it empty if the server has one model and ignores the name.

advice.title: Nothing at that path
advice.what: The server answered “404 Not Found” at POST {url}.
advice.why: It gave the same answer as for a made-up path, so no route exists there.
advice.fix: Check the path with whoever set the server up. If the server uses OpenAI-style paths such as /v1/audio/transcriptions, go back and pick “Any OpenAI-compatible server”.

advice.title: That path does not accept audio
advice.what: The server answered “405 Method Not Allowed” at POST {url}.
advice.why: A path that takes audio accepts a POST request. This one does not.
advice.fix: Check the path with whoever set the server up.
